title: Close cross-repository tasks by rule
body:
GLOBAL has no tracker, so work done in GLOBAL is tracked by a Product task, and the task can only be closed by a separate Product PR after the GLOBAL merge (e.g. t-yxxfg7k). Decide and document one rule for cross-repository tasks: which PR closes the task, and which `Ticket:` value GLOBAL commits carry (today `LON-319`).
Acceptance: the rule is documented in the repository workflow and the tracker or preflight enforces it.
